details.description: RKS Herbal Henna for natural black hair colour and grey coverage. Pack of 3 boxes of 60g.
details.usageInstructions: Mix the powder with water into a paste, apply on hair, leave for 1 to 2 hours and rinse.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.
